title: Confirm it's you
why: This action is protected. Enter your password to go on.
codeWhy: Your account has two-factor sign-in: enter a code too.
sent: Code sent to {to}. It works for ten minutes.
tooManySends: Too many codes sent. Try again in 15 minutes.
unreachable: There's no address to send that code to. Try another way.
notSent: The code couldn't be sent. Try another way, or again later.
notAllowed: This site doesn't send codes that way.
strongWhy: This action needs more than your password: your passkey, or your password and a code from your authenticator app.
usePasswordAndApp: Use your password and authenticator app instead
passkeyPrompt: Follow your device's prompt to use your passkey.
passkeyCancelled: The passkey wasn't used. Try again, or use another way.
passkeyUnsupported: This browser can't use passkeys here.
setupTitle: Set up a passkey or authenticator
setupWhy: This action needs a passkey or an authenticator app, and you don't have one yet. Set one up now; you'll then confirm with it.
appScan: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
appQrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
appCantScan: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:
appWrongCode: That code is incorrect. Check the time on your phone, and enter the code it shows now.
recoveryHint: Each one signs you in once if you lose your device. They won't be shown again.
strongWhyApp: This action needs more than your password: enter it with a code from your authenticator app.
appCodeWhy: Enter a code from your authenticator app.
useAppCode: Use a code from your authenticator app instead
